description: The bar chart illustrates F1 Score performance (in percent) across multiple datasets for several MADLLM ablation variants, shown as grouped bars for each dataset. The horizontal axis contains the categorical dataset labels ordered left to right as SMD, PSM, SWaT, SMAP, MSL, and WADI, with the axis label “Dataset.” The vertical axis is the value axis labeled “F1 Score (%)” on a linear scale spanning approximately 60 to 100, with tick marks at 60, 70, 80, 90, and 100. For each dataset, four adjacent bars are displayed: a green bar (unlabeled in the legend text but visually present as the first bar in each group), a blue bar labeled “MADLLM w/o prompt pool,” a purple bar labeled “MADLLM w/o feature embedding,” and an orange bar labeled “MADLLM w/o skip embedding.” Approximate bar heights by dataset are: SMD—green ~93, purple ~91, blue ~92, orange ~92; PSM—green ~97, purple ~96, blue ~77, orange ~95; SWaT—green ~91, purple ~90, blue ~83, orange ~85; SMAP—green ~93, purple ~69, blue ~69, orange ~67; MSL—green ~87, purple ~85, blue ~69, orange ~85; WADI—green ~74, purple ~62, blue ~64, orange ~68. The bars are grouped by dataset rather than sorted by value, and there are no visible annotations, outlines, or other emphasis beyond the distinct bar colors and the legend.
